note: Adapted from the original description of Termes caffrariae by Sjöstedt (1900), in German and Latin, with heavy OCR noise; only the alate is treated, soldiers and workers being unrecorded; the upper limit of wing width is omitted owing to damaged text; synonymy, figure numbers and locality records are not translated.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Closely related to T. destructor, from which it differs in the slightly larger, darker, differently shaped and less transparent wings. The wing apex is almost as dark as the base, whereas in T. destructor the wings become paler, thinner and more transparent towards the apex; in the present species the veins remain very distinct right to the wing apex, whereas in T. destructor they are less raised and blurred near the apex; the wing surface is rather dull in the present species and brighter in T. destructor. T. destructor looks distinctive because its wings are more transparent outwards and its whole appearance brighter, so that the two species are distinguishable at a glance. Specimens from different localities are completely identical.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Ground colour of body with head blackish brown; outer half of the tibiae and the tarsi slightly paler; mouthparts yellowish. Wing span 38–41 mm; body length with wings 22–23 mm; wing length 18–19 mm; body length with head 12 mm.
